newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB's Australasian profits slide in Q3.
newsitem.headline: NAB's Australasian profits slide in Q3.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), under heavy margin pressure, posted significantly lower profits from its Australian and New Zealand operations in the quarter to June 30, 1997, NAB's third quarter results show.

NAB's Australian operations contributed operating profit after tax and goodwill of A$292 million in the June quarter, down 15.3 percent from the A$345 million posted in the March quarter and down 6.7 percent from the A$313 million posted in the same quarter a year earlier.
NAB's New Zealand profits, also under margin pressure, fell to A$44 million in the June quarter from A$47 million in the March quarter and A$51 million in the same quarter a year earlier.
Earlier NAB posted a third quarter group net profit of A$504 million, down from A$557 million in the March quarter and A$505 million in the June quarter a year earlier.
Analysts had forecast profits of about A$545 million for the quarter.
NAB's share price had slumped 50 cents to A$19.00 by 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT).
